name: wallet-card
title: Wallet Card
description: A stack of payment-style cards with a pointer sheen: pick one to bring it forward, mask the balance and see who shares it.

props.name: accounts
props.description: Cards to stack: id, label, balance, currency and optional holder, last4, expiry, network ('visa' | 'mastercard' | 'amex' | 'generic'), gradient.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Controlled id of the card in front. Pair with onActiveChange.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Called when a card is picked by click or arrow keys.

props.name: hidden
props.description: Controlled balance mask. Pair with onHiddenChange.

props.name: onHiddenChange
props.description: Called when the hide/show balance button is pressed.

props.name: members
props.description: People sharing the wallet, shown as overlapping avatars; extras past four collapse behind a +N toggle.

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls rendered at the right of the member row.

props.name: stackOffset
props.description: Vertical offset in px between stacked cards.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
